description: Came in with her, and did not measure the neighbours' bread.
name: Alse Pinder

description: Tapped the bells' rhythm on the doorpost.
name: Augustine Phillips

description: Stayed twenty minutes and took Alse in.
name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell

description: Stayed at the door of the close.
name: Gillis Verbeke

description: Walked you home, and pointed out the boy.
name: Will Kemp

description: Looked at the bonfire, and was not himself in the picture.
name: William Shakespeare
